title: ever GLAMOUR|Deep V-Neck Sequin Sleeveless Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a dazzling entrance in our Deep V-Neck Sequin Sleeveless Evening Dress! This stunning gown features a plunging neckline and a figure-flattering silhouette, adorned with shimmering sequins that catch the light beautifully. Perfect for galas, weddings, or any special occasion where you want to shine!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
